postings.title: (Senior) Backend Engineer C++ (All genders)
postings.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems - not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe - today.

About the team

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments.We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.

Your mission

This is not a "standard" backend role. You won't be building CRUD apps for a web store. You will be building the high-performance, low-latency engine at the heart of Minerva Frontline, our Command & Control (C2) Software, enabling mission planning and operations of Aerial and Maritime asset swarms in real world conditions.
We are looking for C++ developers to build out our core server-side architecture enabling the increasingly complex CONOPS required by NATO’s Armed forces. You will be responsible for how we maintain a global battlefield state, how we translate high-level operator intents into machine-executable actions, and how we stream real-time telemetry to the frontline.
You will work in a high-density engineering environment alongside robotics, safety, and mission planning experts. If you care about RAII, memory safety, and squeezing every ounce of performance out of real hardware in the field to ensure mission success, this is the role.
What You'll Build

- The System Brain: You will develop the core C++ services that orchestrate UAV and USV swarms, maintaining a synchronized and robust battlefield state across distributed systems.
- Mission Control APIs: You will design and implement high-performance gRPC and REST APIs that bridge the gap between our frontend C2 interface and the autonomous vehicles in the field.
- Real-Time Data Pipelines: You will build and optimize the telemetry pipelines that handle high-frequency data from diverse sensors, ensuring low-latency synchronization and delivery.
- Scalable Architecture: You will expand our current C++ architecture to support "affordable mass"—scaling from controlling 4 to 20+ vehicles simultaneously.
- Tactical Integration: You will implement military standards and protocols (such as STANAG), ensuring our systems are interoperable and battle-ready.
- Robustness & Testing: You will build and maintain the test suites, ensuring our code performs reliably under the most contested conditions.

Responsibilities

- A C++ Native: You write clean, performant Modern C++ (17/20/23). You understand the cost of every allocation and the value of a deterministic system.
- Systems-Minded: You think in terms of data flows, state machines, and concurrency. You understand that in our domain, "late data is wrong data."
- A Problem Solver: You dive deep into the details to identify, understand, and solve difficult technical problems at the hardware-software boundary.
- High Agency: You don't wait for perfect specifications. You understand the mission, look at the code, and drive the architecture forward.
- Collaborative: You thrive in a multidisciplinary team, working closely with frontend, robotics, and integration engineers to deliver a cohesive product.

Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in backend or systems engineering, with a primary focus on high-performance C++ applications.
- C++ Expertise: Deep proficiency in Modern C++ (17 or later).
- Networking: Strong understanding of asynchronous networking, inter-process communication (IPC), and real-time data streaming.
- Industry Context: Relevant experience in Aerospace, Robotics, Automotive, Sensors, or High-Frequency Trading—any domain where software interacts with the physical world in real-time.
- Bonus Skills: Familiarity with autopilot/flight control systems (MAVLink/PX4/ArduPilot), geospatial data handling (GIS), or building safety-critical software systems.

Why Join STARK?

- Impact: Build the software that NATO militaries rely on when stakes are highest. Your code will directly influence the outcome of critical missions.
- Engineering Excellence: Work in a culture where technical rigor and architectural beauty are valued. We don't cut corners on safety or performance.
- Novelty: Solve "Genesis-stage" engineering problems for autonomous swarming that have no off-the-shelf solution.
- Growth: As we scale our platforms from the North Sea to the edges of Europe, your role and impact on the organization will grow with us.

If interested in this opportunity, send us your CV in English, and we will reach out to you soon!

· IT Systems Understanding: Good practical understanding of computers, operating systems, network devices, routers, interfaces, peripheral hardware, and system configuration in technical environments.

· Linux & Networking: Experience working with Linux-based systems and basic networking concepts such as IP addressing, routing, switching, VLANs, device configuration, and troubleshooting.

· Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, supplier interaction, and documentation are a plus.

· Team Fit: Ability to work collaboratively in a small, cross-functional team and communicate clearly and reliably with engineering, production, supply chain, and testing teams.

Nice to have

· Experience with Ground Control Stations, unmanned systems, drones, robotics, defence systems, or other mission-critical technical platforms.

· Experience integrating IT hardware into vehicles, boats, mobile shelters, field cases, handheld systems, or other ruggedized environments.

· Experience with ruggedized laptops or tablets, routers, switches, radios, antennas, power stations, controllers, displays, and peripheral equipment.

At STARK, you will work directly on the systems that enable operators to control, communicate with, and deploy autonomous platforms in demanding environments. - Strong communication skills: you are comfortable coordinating with external vendors and writing clear, unambiguous instructions/guidelines.

- Basic understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning concepts (e.g., bounding boxes, segmentation masks, object tracking).

- Create Data Tooling: Build the programmatic tools that bridge raw data and downstream usage. This includes writing services to automatically sub-sample video feeds, extract valuable frames, package datasets, and build self-serve data access tools.

- Database & Metadata Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain our metadata databases and data catalogs (tracking datasets, recordings, sensors, labels, and lineage) using solid SQL and schema design principles.

- Data Operations & Labeling Workflows: Own the end-to-end technical workflows for data curation and labeling. You will build the operational tooling and coordinate with external labeling subcontractors to ensure high-quality data deliveries, track progress, and run automated QA.

- Internal Tooling & APIs: Develop backend APIs, self-service dashboards, and data-access tools that allow the entire AI and engineering organization to quickly search, filter, and understand terabytes of multi-sensor data.

- Drive Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce good software engineering hygiene in a young codebase: rigorous testing, typing, documentation, logging, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Generalist Problem Solving: Thrive in an evolving startup environment. Take on ambiguous problems, migrate legacy data, handle access management, and aggressively automate away manual support tasks.

- Strong Software Engineering in Python: You write clean, typed, tested, and maintainable Python code. You approach data problems with a software developer's mindset.

- Data Engineering & ETL: Proven experience designing, building, and operating robust ETL/data ingestion pipelines.

- Database Mastery: Solid SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) with a strong grasp of schema design, data modeling, and metadata systems.

- Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with object storage (GCP/GCS, S3) and the basics of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD.

- Unix/Linux Environments: Strong familiarity with Unix-based systems, shell scripting, and standard Unix tools. You are comfortable working natively in a Linux environment.

- Pragmatic & Adaptable: You know how to balance a quick, scrappy fix with a long-term architectural solution, and you are highly comfortable with the changing priorities of a startup environment.

- Communicator & Coordinator: You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with external vendors and non-technical stakeholders to drive data labeling and curation efforts.

- Data Ecosystems: Familiarity with data versioning (DVC, LakeFS, FiftyOne), computer vision annotation formats (e.g., COCO), or large-scale data curation workflows.

- Advanced GCP: Experience with GCP services beyond basic storage (BigQuery, Cloud Run, IAM).

- Robotics / Complex Data: Exposure to robotics data formats (ROS bags, MCAP, PX4 logs) or handling heavy, multi-modal data streams (video, lidar).

A note on our process: we value critical thinking, grit, and the ability to learn over a perfect checklist. If you don't hit every bullet point but you love building data systems that real engineers depend on every day, we still want to hear from you.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer – Integration and Deployment (All Genders)
postings.description:
About Us

STARK ist ein neuartiges Defence-Tech-Unternehmen, das die Art und Weise revolutioniert, wie autonome Systeme in unterschiedlichen Einsatzdomänen eingesetzt werden. Unser Fokus liegt auf einsatzbereiten Hochleistungssystemen – nicht auf Zukunftsversprechen. In einer Zeit zunehmender Bedrohungen stärkt STARK den technologischen Vorsprung der NATO-Verbündeten und ihrer Partner, um Aggressionen abzuschrecken und Europa schon heute zu verteidigen.

Minerva ist die Command-and-Control-Software (C2) von STARK – das „Gehirn“, das Operatoren in Echtzeit mit autonomen Systemen über verschiedene Domänen hinweg verbindet. Das Minerva-Team ist eine kleine, hochqualifizierte Gruppe erfahrener Softwareentwickler mit Standorten in Berlin und München. Wir arbeiten schnell, liefern echte Software aus und bewegen uns in Rahmenbedingungen, die die meisten Softwareingenieure nie erleben: Netzwerke mit geringer Bandbreite, isolierte (air-gapped) Systeme und hochkritische Entscheidungsprozesse. Bei uns gibt es keine technische Spielerei ohne praktischen Nutzen. Alles, was wir entwickeln, landet direkt in den Händen von Anwendern im Einsatz.

About the team

Wir suchen einen Senior Software Engineer (all genders), der das technische Gesicht von Minerva Frontline gegenüber unseren internen Hardware-Teams, Pilotkunden und Programmpartnern ist. Du bringst Frontline in neue interne und kundenseitige Projekte, verantwortest die technische Integration und gewinnst Vertrauen durch technische Exzellenz – nicht durch Projektmanagement. Wir sind als Team füreinander da!

Your mission

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Software, Hardware und operativer Realität: Du setzt das C++-Backend auf, das UAV-Schwärme orchestriert, integrierst neue Plattformen in laufende Systeme und stellst sicher, dass die Führungs- und Kontrollprozesse auch in isolierten, bandbreitenlimitierten taktischen Umgebungen reibungslos funktionieren.

Wenn im Feld etwas ausfällt, bist du vor Ort und behebst das Problem – unter Zeitdruck und mit dem Kunden direkt an deiner Seite.

Responsibilities

Integration und Deployment

- Arbeit mit Edge-Hardware, eingeschränkten Netzwerken und taktischer Infrastruktur.
- Integration neuer UAV-Plattformen und Funktionen in die Frontline-Plattform.

Analyse und Fehlerbehebung
- Technische Ansprechperson vor Ort für komplexe Systemprobleme.

- Ausfällen oder Verschlechterungen der Schwarm-Telemetrie
- gRPC-Konnektivitätsproblemen
- Fehlern bei der Übersetzung von MAVLink-Kommandos in reale Drohnenaktionen

- Fehlerdiagnose und Problemlösung in Echtzeit.

Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Entwicklung
- Übersetzung von Feedback von Operatoren, Piloten und Kunden in konkrete technische Anforderungen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Engineering-Teams zur Umsetzung von Verbesserungen, Fehlerbehebungen und Plattformintegrationen.

Validierung im Einsatz
- Teilnahme an Flugtests und Erprobungskampagnen.
- Sicherstellung, dass Softwarebefehle zuverlässig und präzise in physische Drohnenaktionen umgesetzt werden – auch unter realen Einsatzbedingungen.

Entwicklung von Tools
- Entwicklung eigener Werkzeuge, wenn Standardlösungen nicht ausreichen:
- Skripte
- Diagnose-Tools
- Integrations- und Testumgebungen

- Ziel ist es, Deployments reproduzierbar, effizient und robust zu gestalten.

Arbeit auf dem Feld
- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Hardware-Ingenieuren, Drohnenplattformen und Testequipment.
- Regelmäßige Einsätze bei Kunden und auf Testgeländen gehören fest zum Aufgabenbereich.

Qualifications

- Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik, Robotik, Systems Engineering oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in modernem C++ (C++17/20/23).
- Sicher im Lesen, Debuggen und Anpassen produktiver C++-Codebasen.
- Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb komplexer verteilter Systeme.
- Praktische Kenntnisse in:
- Echtzeitfähigen verteilten Systemen
- gRPC
- Flatbuffers
- WebSockets
- MAVLink / MAVSDK

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung bei der Einführung und dem Betrieb von Softwarelösungen bei externen Kunden.
- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Hardware-Teams während Flugtests und Plattformintegrationen.

- Aufgrund der Art unserer Arbeit müssen Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten die Voraussetzungen für eine entsprechende Sicherheitsüberprüfung erfüllen.

Interessiert?
Wenn du gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der europäischen Verteidigung gestalten möchtest und dich in dieser Beschreibung wiederfindest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf in englischer Sprache.
Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

- Keep the fleet mission-ready: maintenance, repairs, spare parts, battery management, and configuration control

- Maintain flight logs and campaign documentation so every flight produces usable, traceable data

- Ensure operations comply with aviation regulations (EU drone rules) and internal safety procedures

Qualifications

- Solid practical knowledge of PX4 and/or ArduPilot: configuration, parameter tuning, log analysis, MAVLink basics

- Practical, structured, and safety-conscious — you find the loose cable before it becomes a crash

- Willingness to travel regularly for field campaigns and work outdoors in various conditions

- Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)
